configurations.//: 5201, NOT 5200. The sibling checkout ~/Claude/coretrack-mindtree runs its own vite on 5200, and because both configs used --strictPort the loser silently failed to bind while the browser happily served the OTHER repo's app. It looked exactly like a stale bundle: the page said CoreTrack while this repo's index.html and locale bundles said NphiesCore. Keep this port unique to nphiescore.
